1.title: Inflation Complicates Trump’s Midterms Pitch to Voters
1.summary: Gas prices are high, mortgage rates are climbing and inflation remains well above target, complicating the president’s midterm appeal.

2.title: Alabama Is Set to Execute a Murderer. The Jury Wanted Him to Live.
2.summary: Jeffery Lee’s case has grappled with questions in Alabama about emerging execution methods and an abandoned sentencing practice that sent him and others to death row.

3.title: How Trump Is Wielding Power to Stifle Speech
3.summary: President Trump has harnessed agencies across the government to curtail press freedoms, a sweeping campaign that free speech advocates say will have lasting effects.

4.title: A united Ireland would be 'fantastic' says Trump during Irish visit
4.summary: Trump is holding meetings in Dublin before attending the Irish Open golf tournament in Doonbeg, County Clare.

5.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
5.summary: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

6.title: Visa Issue Threatens U.S.-Brazil Cooperation on Crime
6.summary: Officials say the Trump administration is blocking some of Brazil’s efforts to expand cooperation on fighting transnational crime.
